rule: Numeric equality never joins different namespaces. A relation requires a typed, build-scoped edge.

namespaces.name: ctb_table_key
namespaces.rule: Static table identity; stable only inside a deployment/build inventory.

namespaces.name: ctb_row_id
namespaces.rule: A row ID is not globally unique and must retain its table key.

namespaces.name: localization_id
namespaces.rule: Localized text key; locale is selected separately at lookup time.

namespaces.name: skill_id
namespaces.rule: Static skill definition identity.

namespaces.name: skill_effect_id
namespaces.rule: Static level/effect definition identity; not interchangeable with skill ID.

namespaces.name: buff_id
namespaces.rule: Static buff/debuff definition identity.

namespaces.name: temporary_attribute_id
namespaces.rule: Static temporary combat attribute identity.

namespaces.name: fight_attribute_id
namespaces.rule: Static character/combat attribute identity.

namespaces.name: damage_id
namespaces.rule: Damage/heal event definition identity; RecountTable stores arrays as signed 64-bit integers.

namespaces.name: recount_id
namespaces.rule: Display grouping for one or more damage IDs.

namespaces.name: scene_id
namespaces.rule: Static scene definition identity.

namespaces.name: map_id
namespaces.rule: Static map definition identity.

namespaces.name: dungeon_id
namespaces.rule: Static dungeon definition identity.

namespaces.name: monster_id
namespaces.rule: Static monster template identity.

namespaces.name: npc_id
namespaces.rule: Static NPC template identity.

namespaces.name: entity_definition_id
namespaces.rule: Static placement/configuration identity; never a runtime entity UUID.

namespaces.name: runtime_entity_uuid
namespaces.rule: Dynamic packet identity scoped to runtime evidence and capture session.

namespaces.name: character_uid
namespaces.rule: Public game character identity; distinct from prohibited account/open/login identifiers.

namespaces.name: asset_address_hash
namespaces.rule: Static asset catalog address hash.

namespaces.name: network_route
namespaces.rule: Protocol route identity; never represented by a bare opcode alone.
